title: Kabut Sikunir
subject: riding a motorbike up to Sikunir hill on the Dieng plateau at four in the morning with a friend to see the sunrise, and seeing nothing but white fog
caption: Indonesian shoegaze in the Bandung and Medan scene style. Walls of fuzzed electric guitars with reverse reverb and slow tremolo-bar bends; a steady mid-tempo drum kit with washed, smeared cymbals; a melodic electric bass carrying the main tune under the noise; a soft organ drone holding the chord. Dense and blurred, loud but soft-edged, long reverb tails, the vocals buried in the guitars. Female voice, a breathy calm soprano mixed low, a male voice doubling an octave below. 112 BPM, F-sharp major. Hazy, cold, quietly delighted. No clean pop vocal up front, no trap beat, no autotune, no metal riffing, no acoustic guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - fuzzed guitars swelling]

[Verse 1]
Jam empat pagi, kita sewa motor matic
Jaket pinjaman ibu homestay, baunya kapur barus
Tanjakan Dieng, lampu motor cuma sampai dua meter
Kamu peluk aku dari belakang, katanya biar hangat

[Pre-Chorus]
Di atas bukit orang udah pegang kamera
Semua nunggu, semua diam

[Chorus]
Putih, semuanya putih
Mataharinya ada, tapi entah di mana
Putih, semuanya putih
Yang kelihatan cuma kamu, hidungmu merah

[Verse 2]
Jam enam, orang mulai turun pelan-pelan
Kamu beli kentang goreng sama teh di gelas plastik
Tanganmu gemeter, tehnya tumpah setengah
Kamu bilang, udah, ini juga pemandangan

[Pre-Chorus]
Foto kita isinya cuma kabut
Dua muka nyengir di pojokan

[Chorus]
Putih, semuanya putih
Mataharinya ada, tapi entah di mana
Putih, semuanya putih
Tahun depan kita naik lagi, siapa tahu

[Outro - guitars dissolve into organ drone]
Motor matic, jaket kapur barus
Kabutnya ikut pulang di rambutmu
